description: The ten indicators behind today's Zensei Index, each with its current status, the layer it scores into, its weight in that layer, and the same explanation the website shows. Use it to explain why the index sits where it does. Indicator statuses run from healthiest to most stressed: Clear or Inactive (no stress), Watch (early warning), Stress (confirmed stress), Activated or Danger (full signal). Calibrating means not enough data yet; Unknown means no data.
name: zensei_index_indicators
